props.title: Paris
props.subtitle: The City of Light · France's Eternal Capital

props.text: Paris is one of the world's most visited cities — a timeless blend of iconic landmarks, world-class cuisine, art, and romance [1]. In 2026 the city is buzzing with new energy: the **Grand Palais** has reopened after a €466M renovation, and you can now **swim in the Seine** for the first time in over a century [2].
